description: Vertical 1080x1920 React Three Fiber scene, dark void background. Frame 0 shows giant low-poly passenger jet model in fg=white with muted=grey metalness, frozen horizontal centered at 45% vertical (safe middle band, nothing in top 10% or bottom 25%). Cyan rim light left, accent2=magenta rim right. Directly under fuselage a large glowing accent=cyan 3D arrow mesh pointing up, emissive, pulsing. Subtle star dust particles in muted=grey. Camera is front-three-quarter slightly below, slow push-in with slight orbit for depth.

beats.action: giant jet fades in frozen center-frame as large cyan up-arrow fades in below it
jet wobbles slightly down then holds, showing it is not floating
cyan arrow starts pulsing glow rhythmically under fuselage
arrow scales taller and pushes up into belly, jet lifts a touch
camera pushes in as arrow flashes bright cyan and lifts jet visibly

description: Same dark void React Three Fiber scene, side-view. fg=white passenger jet profile centered at 45% vertical flying left-to-right, extruded 3D with thickness for depth. muted=grey fog. Hundreds of thin fg=white speed-line streak meshes stream right-to-left past jet. Warm key light. Camera tracks side-on with slight parallax. Jet first sinks then accelerates forward.

beats.action: jet drops slightly down and tilts nose-down to feel heavy
363 Weight label implied by jet scale grows larger, jet sinks lower
empty space below jet emphasized, fog clears to show nothing holding it
white speed-lines burst on and stream fast past jet
camera shakes slightly and streaks stretch longer as jet rushes forward at full speed

description: React Three Fiber close-up of 3D wing cross-section airfoil extruded in depth, metallic muted=grey with fg=white highlight, tilted about 3 degrees nose-up, centered at 45% vertical. Four small emissive accent=cyan spheres representing air puffs flow in level from left in two rows above and below. Behind wing their trails bend sharply down using tube meshes. Large accent3=yellow 3D up-arrow grows from top center of wing. Dark background, angled camera 20 degrees off side to show depth and thickness, slow dolly in.

beats.action: camera cuts to close-up wing cross-section centered, four cyan puffs appear left
wing slides forward right while cyan puffs stream toward it level
lower puffs hit bottom of wing and deflect down, upper puffs stretch over top
wing highlights tilt angle with faint yellow arc showing 3-degree tilt
all four trails bend sharply downward behind wing forming downwash
accent3-yellow up-arrow grows large from wing center as downwash strengthens

description: React Three Fiber wide shot, same jet model now level cruising left-to-right at 45% vertical in dark blue-black sky. Two soft volumetric trails in accent=cyan and muted=grey curl downward below wings and trail behind, curving down to show downwash. fg=white jet with accent2=magenta rim. Gentle god-ray. Camera follows alongside with slow pull-back revealing longer trails, slight orbit for 3D depth. Nothing in top 10% or bottom 25%.

beats.action: wide jet cruises level center-frame leaving faint level contrails
trails brighten cyan and start curling downward below wings
camera pushes to wings as downwash tubes thicken and glow
animated cyan particles fire continuously downward from wings
trails curl strongly down and back, jet rides steadily on reaction
soft yellow up-glow pulses under wings as jet holds altitude cruising forward
